title: Military English
scope: Military language learning: small-unit terminology, administrative radio communication, weapons and equipment identification, document comprehension, briefings and safety reporting.

references.use: Terminology and topic reference; lesson prose is original and is not an official translation.

references.publication: ATP 3-21.8, Infantry Rifle Platoon and Squad
references.edition: January 2024; verify applicable changes during review

reviewNeeded: Bilingual military subject-matter review of definitions and Spanish equivalents, including country-specific unit and rank names.
Radio procedure terminology review against the intended service and applicable communications publication.
Expand classroom readings into richer authentic dialogues and add reviewed source excerpts where appropriate.
Check progression with Spanish-speaking English learners and assess listening, speaking, reading and writing independently.
limitations: No DLI affiliation, official test preparation designation or ILR certification is claimed.
Audio uses the existing app playback path; no new recorded voice assets or offline speech engine are included.
Weapons lessons teach names, distinctions and safety-reporting language, not operating procedures.
